body.statement: For nonempty compact convex \(K_1,K_2\subset\mathbb C_{\mathcal Z,h_n}\) contained in the closed radius-\(\mathsf R\) ball, \(d_H(K_1,K_2)\le\max_{v\in\mathcal D_n}|h_{K_1}(v)-h_{K_2}(v)|+2\mathsf R\delta_n\).
body.justification: The finite-net inequality converts support calibration on finitely many directions into Hausdorff control with an explicit geometric remainder.
body.gap: Generic support-function identities take a supremum over the full dual ball; the gridded finite-dimensional reduction records the exact net remainder needed for the changing-contact rate.
body.consumer: It makes the empirical-process prerequisite finite in the direction coordinate and exposes its \(\log|\mathcal D_n|\) cost.
